mimas.title: Cassini global map of Mimas
mimas.attribution: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute/Lunar and Planetary Institute
mimas.license: JPL image use policy: reuse permitted with attribution; no endorsement.
mimas.notes: Cassini ISS global mosaic (2014 release) in enhanced IR3/green/UV colour; chroma reduced to about 12% for approximately natural saturation. Source illumination is baked in. Re-projected to 0 deg longitude at the center.

iapetus.license: JPL image use policy: reuse permitted with attribution; no endorsement.
iapetus.notes: Cassini ISS global mosaic (2014 release); brightness from the source, colour replaced by a luminance-dependent tint: the dark Cassini Regio material is reddish-brown (very red spectral slope), the bright ice neutral. Hue is approximate. Source illumination is baked in. Re-projected to 0 deg longitude at the center.

pluto.attribution: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Southwest Research Institute
pluto.license: JPL image use policy: reuse permitted with attribution; no endorsement.
pluto.notes: New Horizons LORRI/MVIC global colour mosaic (2015 flyby). The southern hemisphere was in polar night and was never imaged; it is transparent in this map. Re-projected to 0 deg longitude at the center.

charon.title: New Horizons LORRI/MVIC global mosaic of Charon
charon.license: USGS source: no access constraints; cite authors.
charon.notes: New Horizons panchromatic mosaic (USGS 1024-pixel preview). The unobserved southern hemisphere is transparent in this map. Re-projected to 0 deg longitude at the center.

ceres.notes: Dawn FC global mosaic (USGS 1024-pixel preview). Source illumination is baked in. Re-projected to 0 deg longitude at the center.

triton.title: Voyager 2 colour mosaic of Triton
triton.license: USGS source: no access constraints; cite authors.
triton.notes: Voyager 2 (1989) colour mosaic. Voyager saw mainly the southern hemisphere; the rest is transparent in this map. Re-projected to 0 deg longitude at the center.

uranus.title: Hubble OPAL Uranus map (2014) in true colour
uranus.attribution: NASA / ESA / STScI / OPAL program (PI: Amy Simon); colour: Irwin et al. 2024
uranus.license: MAST/HST data: public domain, cite the OPAL program; colour reference Irwin et al. 2024 (MNRAS 527:11521).
uranus.notes: Hubble OPAL filter-composite brightness structure re-centred on the true colour measured from Irwin et al. 2024's reprocessed Voyager 2 disk; 30% of the composite's relative colour variation is kept. Unobserved and registration-fringe latitudes use a zonal-mean continuation (illustrative). Historical weather; native resolution only, no upscaling.
